mainSteps.title: Settle into Reborn City and start the League challenge

route.what: Follow the opening events through the Grand Hall and out into the Wards.
Work your way through Peridot Ward; a few story errands stand between you and the first gym.
Take the first gym challenge.

mainSteps.title: Head through Obsidia to Onyx Trainers' School

route.what: Make your way through the Slums.
Continue the story through Coral Ward.
Take the next gym challenge.

namedBattles: Victoria and Cain (Obsidia Slums / Coral Ward)

mainSteps.title: Go on to Rhodochrine Jungle, the Grand Stairway and Lapis Ward

route.where: Malchous Forest Park and Rhodochrine Jungle
route.what: Follow the story out to the forest park and the jungle.
Continue to Beryl Ward.

route.where: Grand Stairway and North Obsidia Ward
route.what: Push on through the Grand Stairway and back up into North Obsidia Ward.
Take the next gym challenge in Lapis Ward.

mainSteps.title: Visit Dr. Connal's Orphanage, then the Yureyu Power Plant

route.where: Lapis Ward and Dr. Connal's Orphanage
route.what: Follow the story to the orphanage.
Take the next gym challenge at the power plant.

mainSteps.title: Work through the Blacksteam Factory, Apophyll Academy and the Wasteland

route.what: Make your way through the factory.
Continue the story at the academy.
Cross to the mountain and the island.
Take the next gym challenge at the end of the Wasteland.

mainSteps.title: Cross Yureyu HQ to Spinel Town and the Voclain Estate

route.what: Finish up in the Wasteland and head back toward the city.
Continue the story at the Yureyu HQ.
Take the next gym challenge in Spinel Town.

namedBattles: Dr. Sigmund Connal or Sirius (Yureyu HQ)

mainSteps.title: Cross Tanzan Mountain to Tanzan Cove

route.what: Follow the story at the manse before heading into the mountain.
Climb through Tanzan Mountain; Tanzan Depths branches off it.
Get through the base hidden in the mountain (it has a colour-tile puzzle).
Take the next gym challenge at the cove.

namedBattles: Dr. Sigmund Connal or Sirius (Belrose Manse)

mainSteps.title: Make for Route 1, Citae Astrae and Vanhanen Castle

route.what: Head out along Route 1.
Work through the logic puzzles.
Take the next gym challenge in the castle (it has a chess-themed puzzle).

mainSteps.title: Go through Subseven Sanctum to Iolia Valley

route.what: Make your way through the Sanctum.
Take the next gym challenge in the valley.

mainSteps.title: Travel to the Agate Circus and Big Top

route.what: Follow the story to the circus.
Take the next gym challenge in the big top.
Cross Route 2 and continue on to the mansion.
Take the next gym challenge in Calcenon.

mainSteps.title: Continue to Ametrine City and beyond

route.what: Follow the story up through Ametrine.
Take the next gym challenge in an unusual place.

mainSteps.title: Work through the Water Treatment Center and Fiore Mansion

route.what: Make your way through the Center.
Continue the story at the mansion.
Take the next gym challenge back at the big top.

namedBattles: Pokemon Stopple, Taka and Ace (Water Treatment Center)
Kenan & Diana, Blake & Fern, Solaris & John (Fiore Mansion)

mainSteps.title: Investigate Devon Corp, then go to Coral Gym

route.what: Follow the story through the corporation's building.
Take the next gym challenge in Coral Ward.

mainSteps.title: Cross the Tourmaline Desert to Never After

route.what: Cross the desert.
Take the next gym challenge.
Take the next gym challenge at the arena (it has its own puzzle).

mainSteps.title: Go through the Glass Workstation to Agate Arena

route.what: Make your way through the workstation.
Take the next gym challenge at the arena.
Follow the story through the city and arena.
Take the last gym challenge.

mainSteps.title: Cross Victory Road to the Pokemon League

route.what: Work through Victory Road's areas in order.
Take on the Pokemon League.

namedBattles: The Elite Four and Champion (Charous Hall)

optional.title: Magikarp errand chain
optional.needs: Pocket money and patience; it spans about 14 gyms.
optional.hint: A fisherman near the Grand Hall entrance sells a rare Pokemon; things go wrong from there.

optional.title: Day-Care Couple rescue
optional.where: Obsidia Ward (Pokemon Day Care, east of the Pokemon Center)
optional.needs: A normal battle team.
optional.hint: The Day-Care Couple keep shooing you away. Keep talking to them.

optional.title: Department Store sticker cards
optional.where: Obsidia Department Store, plus sticker NPCs around the Wards
optional.needs: Sticker-collecting takes a while; later stickers open as you earn more badges.
optional.hint: Eleven stickers for the membership card; most are earned by talking to certain NPCs.

optional.title: Rainbow Scent (Obsidia version)
optional.needs: Three flower-themed Pokemon to show an NPC.
optional.hint: Talk to the woman in Obsidia Park. This version closes after the orphanage events.

optional.title: House raid errand (opens the gang errands)
optional.where: Lapis Ward (house below the Pokemon Center)
optional.needs: A normal battle team; the reward depends on which gang you sided with.
optional.hint: Your gang leader will point you to the house.

optional.title: Bicycle
optional.where: Lapis Ward (old woman's house, then the Bicycle shop below it)
optional.needs: Finish the house raid errand first.
optional.hint: A Growlithe at the door shows the quest is ready. You get a Bike Voucher; trading it in is optional.

optional.title: Missing police officers
optional.where: Jasper Ward police station (then Jasper Ward, Beryl Ward, Rhodochrine Jungle and the Underroot)
optional.needs: Time-sensitive: it can no longer be finished once you earn the 7th badge.
optional.hint: Talk to the Police Chief first, otherwise the officers do not appear.

optional.title: Gang raid errand
optional.where: North Obsidia Alleyway or Lapis Alleyway (depends on your gang)
optional.needs: Finish the house raid errand first; a team that can handle a few grunts and a gang leader.
optional.hint: Talk to your gang leader to start it.

optional.title: Aron sticker
optional.needs: Rock Smash.
optional.hint: Follow the escalators on the right side of the Slums.

optional.title: Dawn Stone (first copies)
optional.where: Mining, then Byxbysion Grotto after the 4th badge
optional.needs: Pickaxe-style mining; later copies appear in more places.
optional.hint: More copies turn up in Opal Ward, the Department Store and further on.

optional.title: Silvally Memory: Dragon
optional.needs: Check the wiki guide for the puzzle or fight involved.
optional.hint: One of the 17 Memory discs.

optional.title: Starter special encounters
optional.where: Byxbysion Wasteland, Pyrous Mountain, Azurine Island and others
optional.needs: Pokeballs and time; these start the egg collection for a later quest.
optional.hint: Several of the 21 starters can be found well before the quest that asks for their eggs.

optional.title: Missing furniture errand
optional.needs: Walking around town; the reward is the Exp. All (or a Reborn Ball if you already have it).
optional.hint: A girl's furniture vanishes when you first enter her house.

optional.title: Eeveelution petting
optional.where: Spinel Town (house left of the Pokemon Center)
optional.needs: Spotting all eight Eeveelutions across Reborn; some vanish over time.
optional.hint: Reward is a Choice Scarf and the Eevee-starter password.

optional.title: Silvally Memory: Bug
optional.needs: Check the wiki guide for the exact trigger.
optional.hint: Another of the 17 Memory discs.

optional.title: Museum fossil reward
optional.needs: A team that can beat a few grunts. Missed once the mountain's base is destroyed.
optional.hint: Talk to the suspicious people in the museum; they run off to the mountain.

optional.title: Solrock and Lunatone
optional.needs: PokeSnax in your bag to lure them out.
optional.hint: A static encounter near the mountain entrance.

optional.title: Tara's Identity
optional.where: Tanzan Meteor Base (talk to Simon), then back at Tanzan Cove
optional.needs: Starts as soon as you enter the base; the reward includes a Super Rod.
optional.hint: Cannot be done once postgame starts.

optional.title: Giant wild Pokemon in Tanzan Depths
optional.needs: A strong, well-rounded team. Optional.
optional.hint: A boss-sized wild Pokemon.

optional.title: Silvally Memory: Psychic
optional.needs: Check the wiki guide.
optional.hint: Another Memory disc.

optional.title: Vanhanen Castle chess puzzles
optional.needs: Patience; the puzzles can be skipped.
optional.hint: The castle's chess-themed rooms.

optional.title: Type: Null special encounter
optional.where: 7th Street (dark alley left of the Subseven Sanctum entrance)
optional.needs: A good team for the encounter.
optional.hint: Talk to the lead scientist in the alley.

optional.title: Route 2 secrets
optional.needs: Crustle-style jumping puzzles.
optional.hint: Detours off the main path.

optional.title: TMX3 Surf
optional.needs: Your team needs to survive the mansion's trainers.
optional.hint: A water field move.

optional.title: TMX6 Dive
optional.needs: Surf first.
optional.hint: An underwater field move.

optional.title: TMX5 Waterfall
optional.needs: Surf first.
optional.hint: A waterfall-climbing field move.

optional.title: TMX2 Fly
optional.needs: Surf and Waterfall help getting there.
optional.hint: Fast travel field move.

optional.title: Devon Corp walkthrough
optional.needs: Puzzles and several battles.
optional.hint: The corporation building's later floors.

optional.title: Starter Egg Quest
optional.where: Grand Hall basement (after donating to a restoration project)
optional.needs: Eggs of all 21 starter Pokemon.
optional.hint: Hand in every starter's egg to the NPC down in the basement.

optional.title: TMX9 Rock Climb
optional.needs: Your team to clear the route.
optional.hint: A climbing field move.

optional.title: Spirit hunt
optional.where: Victory Road (Pokemon Center just before it)
optional.needs: A strong team: 25 optional trainers with unique fields.
optional.hint: Rewards every five spirits beaten.

optional.title: Postgame quests (Nightclub)
optional.needs: Finish the League first; quests are grouped in tiers with rising level caps.
optional.hint: The Nightclub is the hub for everything after the credits.
